incidents.title: Payment API TLS handshake failure — partial outage
incidents.description: Payment API returning SSL errors intermittently. 12% of transactions failing at TLS handshake.
incidents.root_cause: DNS propagation delay post cert rotation — OCSP stapling misconfigured

incidents.title: Notification service DB connection pool exhausted — cascading impact to payment-api
incidents.description: Notification service hitting DB connection limit under Black Friday load. Causing downstream timeouts in payment-api checkout flow.
incidents.root_cause: PgBouncer pool size (20) insufficient for peak load. No circuit breaker in payment-api downstream call.
incidents.impact_summary: Checkout flow degraded for 47 minutes. ~3% of orders affected.

incidents.title: Internal dashboard — users unable to login (ACTIVE)
incidents.description: internal-dashboard showing HTTP 503 for all users. Load balancer health checks failing. On-call alerted.
incidents.impact_summary: All internal-dashboard users locked out. Engineering teams unable to access deployment dashboards.
